create_cached_asset_metadata_provider: create a CachedAssetMetadataProvider to serve metadata lookups from an in-memory dictionary of asset names
load_standard_file_asset_metadata: load asset metadata from YAML files in a directory or single file using StandardFileAssetMetadataLoader
load_package_asset_metadata: load asset metadata from YAML files bundled inside a Python namespace package using StandardPackageAssetMetadataLoader
load_in_memory_asset_metadata: load asset metadata entries directly from a sequence of dictionaries using load_in_memory_asset_metadata
canonicalize_asset_name: canonicalize an asset name string by splitting on @ and normalizing the name and environment parts
